scope: Read source and project records, run unit/type checks and list browser tests, synchronize documentation. No application changes or Git integration.

checks.note: Confirmed directly after empty-log compressor statistics failed with KeyError: kept_breakdown; compiler itself succeeded.

historicalEvidence: docs/ai/testing.md records earlier R0/R1 build, M2 24/24 and Playwright 57/57; not rerun in this audit.

findings.summary: Catalog, adjustment cache and scan baseline publish in separate transactions; catalog failures result is not inspected by coordinator.
Market-wide tail is used as sufficient coverage evidence despite the plan requiring target-stock completeness.
Metadata-only revision detection does not retain readable historical versions; append plus historical rewrite can be classified as addition.
Scan provider interface does not decouple training reads from TDX; independent API refresh paths remain.
Trade settings are read globally and corporate-action application depends on adjustment display mode.
Branches alone do not isolate fixed ports, default personal database, build destinations and report output.
